notes: OpenCode 2.x through the service API (#2109 P5b-1). The /new reset is a new API session at the same location plus an archive of the old one (reset_session). The old session's end is the archive's transcript_removed; the new ses_… id is admitted on its first prompt and runs the next turn.

text: The API session is admitted when its first activity lands (P3, #2107): a ses_… transcript_new. Its first state is not pinned — an API session is first seen working (P4; P5a's smoke cells)
The session binds to the one running 2.x service (pid.go servicePIDFor) — there is no client process
Session 1's prompt drives it to working
The 2.x plugin's session.execution.succeeded ends turn 1 (recorded as the canonical Stop hook)
The reset archives session 1: the reader reports it gone (transcript_removed)
A NEW ses_… session — never seen before — is admitted on the next prompt
The next prompt drives the NEW session to working (not session 1)
The 2.x plugin's session.execution.succeeded ends turn 2 (recorded as the canonical Stop hook)
The new session's turn ends in ready
